title: Reseller Account Tier Rate on a Professional Email Seat Catch-Up
content:
On a Professional Email seat catch-up the account-tier rate is the email discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the tier recorded on the account on the charge date.

**Schedule.**
1. Any Microsoft 365 subscription: no account-tier rate, whatever the tier.
2. Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Platinum account: the Platinum email discount percentage.
3. Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Gold account: the Gold email discount percentage.
4. Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Silver account: the Silver email discount percentage.
5. Harborline Mail subscription, Harborline Reseller Bronze account: the Bronze email discount percentage.
6. Any other account: no account-tier rate.

**Effect.** The account-tier rate reduces the seat catch-up charge once, before it is rounded; no other percentage is added to it or compounded with it, and it never reduces a fee or a credit.

**Timing point.** The tier read is the one recorded on the account on the charge date of the seat catch-up.

Example (hypothetical): a seat catch-up on a Harborline Mail Plus subscription billed while the account is recorded as Harborline Reseller Gold takes the Gold email discount percentage.
